newsitem.title: HONG KONG: New HK airport contracts for German, UK firms.
newsitem.headline: New HK airport contracts for German, UK firms.

text.p: A German company, R&M Warme-Schallschutz and Industrieservice GmBH, has won a HK$63.2 million contract to design, manufacture and erect jet blast screens at the new Chek Lap Kok airport, the Airport Authority said in a statement.
These safety screens ensure potentially dangerous jet engine exhaust gases are deflected upwards and away from the terminal, it added.
As part of the same contract, the firm is to also build an engine run-up facility so jet engines can be safely tested near the airport's maintenance area.

Two contracts worth more than HK$80 million for carpets at Chek Lap Kok were awarded to UK-based Brintons Ltd. The first, worth HK$76.1 million, is to design, manufacture, supply and install about 103,000 square metres of broadloom carpet for public areas.
Brintons has also won a HK$8.1 million contract for an additional 18,000 square metres of carpeting in the airport's northwest concourse, the authority added.
Another German company, Wilkhahn, Wilkening & Hahne GmBH, has been awarded a HK$46.4 million contract for 12,500 seats for terminal public areas.
